firstTurn.purpose: Prove model-to-tool invocation and a real workspace side effect.
firstTurn.instruction: Use one available development tool to create the requested probe file with the exact nonce supplied in the prompt, then report completion concisely.

secondTurn.purpose: Prove same-session continuation and another real tool round trip.
secondTurn.instruction: Use one available development tool to read the existing probe file and return the exact nonce it contains.

restartTurn.purpose: Prove durable session replay after the Harness runtime is closed and restarted.
restartTurn.instruction: Without using a tool, return the nonce that was provided in the first turn. The restart prompt itself must not contain that nonce.
